# SteadyRenew

> SteadyRenew is a personal subscription tracker for recurring costs and renewal dates. You add records yourself or from a screenshot; it does not connect to a bank.

Free includes unlimited subscriptions, cloud sync, Bark renewal reminders, multi-currency totals, JSON import and export, 10 AI captures a month, and API and MCP access. Premium is a one-time $9 USD purchase (not a recurring fee) and raises AI captures to 300 a month, with advanced spending reports and PDF download.

- [指南](https://steadyrenew.com/zh/blog/): Chinese guides
- [App](https://steadyrenew.com/app): Subscription list, reminders, and account

## API and MCP

- [API overview](https://steadyrenew.com/docs/en/api/overview): Subscriptions, notification settings, analytics, and audit
- [API authentication](https://steadyrenew.com/docs/en/api/authentication): Bearer API keys
- [Subscriptions API](https://steadyrenew.com/docs/en/api/subscriptions)
- [MCP setup](https://steadyrenew.com/docs/en/user-guide/agent-setup): Local MCP client configuration
- [Developer API keys](https://steadyrenew.com/docs/en/user-guide/developer-api-keys)
- [中文 API 概览](https://steadyrenew.com/docs/zh-CN/api/overview)
- [中文 MCP 接入](https://steadyrenew.com/docs/zh-CN/user-guide/agent-setup)
- [Agent setup prompt](https://steadyrenew.com/agent/setup.md)
- [OpenAPI description](https://steadyrenew.com/agent/openapi.yaml)
- [MCP package](https://steadyrenew.com/downloads/subscription-manager-mcp.tgz): Downloadable local stdio server. There is no hosted remote MCP endpoint.

API routes on this site:

- `GET` `POST` https://steadyrenew.com/api/v1/subscriptions
- `GET` `PATCH` https://steadyrenew.com/api/v1/notification-settings
- `GET` https://steadyrenew.com/api/v1/analytics/summary
- `GET` https://steadyrenew.com/api/v1/analytics/duplicates
- `GET` https://steadyrenew.com/api/v1/analytics/optimizations
- `GET` https://steadyrenew.com/api/v1/audit
